inputs.prompt: ONE original towering spectral giant, the Dreamwake Foganchor Colossus, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the dark iron armour with a tall spiked crown helm, the pale glowing icy-blue face and hands, and the many long flowing ragged wisps of pale blue and white fog that stream from the shoulders, arms and robe like torn cloth. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. The screen-LEFT hand holds a heavy iron chain whose end carries ONE large ship anchor with curved flukes, hanging low beside the legs. Preserve the anchor and chain, the crown helm, the fog wisps and the massive proportions. Make ONE anchor throw toward screen right. The colossus swings the anchor back and up over the shoulder on its chain as the knees bend, then steps into a deep lunge and hurls the anchor straight out on the chain to full reach at screen right, hauls it back in and settles into the original stance. One throw only; the anchor stays on the chain and no swirl or effect appears. Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the whole anchor and chain even at full swing, the crown, the fog wisps, limbs and feet within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, swirling trails, sparks, particles or extra limbs; the fog wisps stay attached to the body and drift gently, and the face and hands keep only their steady pale glow. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; the anchor stays rigid and never morphs.
